		getSummary: (args) => ipc.invoke(`${prefix}:getSummary`, args),
		getDaily: (args) => ipc.invoke(`${prefix}:getDaily`, args),
		getBreakdown: (args) => ipc.invoke(`${prefix}:getBreakdown`, args),
		getRecentSessions: (args) => ipc.invoke(`${prefix}:getRecentSessions`, args)
	};
}

const SESSION_SEARCH_LIMIT_DEFAULT = 20;
const SESSION_SEARCH_LIMIT_MAX = 100;
function resolveSessionSearchLimit(limit) {
	const requested = Number.isInteger(limit) ? limit : 20;
	return Math.min(Math.max(1, requested), 100);
}

refreshGrok: () => electron.ipcRenderer.invoke("rateLimits:refreshGrok"),
	onUpdate: (callback) => {
		const listener = (_event, state) => callback(state);
		electron.ipcRenderer.on("rateLimits:update", listener);
		return () => electron.ipcRenderer.removeListener("rateLimits:update", listener);
	}
};
